summary: Persist browser thread Start and reply intents before dispatch without replaying unknown delivery

replay.detail: Thread Start and reply use the core outbox dispatch permit and delivery observations. Unknown outcomes cannot be retried. Only explicit applied:none permits a deliberate new attempt of the same immutable intent, revalidated and prepared with a fresh snapshot and new action identity; terminal attempts are preserved.

schema.detail: Reuses the browser-local fractal-web-outbox-v1 database introduced for chat; no new browser schema version, server schema changes or authoritative data migration.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrades change.

compatibility.detail: Browser thread sends use the same issuer-scoped durability and visible unprotected mode as chat. Full Start parameters and reply intent are retained before send work. Existing metadata, read and unread thread actions keep their existing contracts.

downtime.detail: No restart, server interruption or additional startup replay is required.

manual.detail: No operator actions, configuration changes or client re-pairing are required.

recovery.detail: Thread attempts share the discard-only recovery list. A restored never-dispatched Start is blocked without canonical recipient revalidation; unknown is never automatically continued. Discarding an in-flight attempt preserves uncertainty and bounds outcome-retention work.
